description: Get the worldwide monthly downloads and revenue estimates for one iOS app, one point per data month (dated its first day). Values are Sensor Tower buckets; downloadsFloor/revenueFloor mark the stored 1,000, which means "< 5K", not an exact figure. missing_months lists the months between the first and the last point for which we hold no estimate: a gap in our data, not a zero. For several apps pass app_ids instead of calling once per app.

app_id.description: App Store ID (numeric ID from the app URL)

app_ids.description: Up to 25 App Store IDs in one call instead of app_id, e.g. every app of a get_rankings chart. Answers { items: [{ app_id, data } or { app_id, error }] }. Each app counts as one call against the monthly limit.

range.description: How many data months to return, newest last: 30d = the newest month, 90d = the newest 3, 1y = the newest 12, all = everything

name: get_revenue_history
title: Get revenue history
